requiredSemantics: persist an ordered release plan before external execution
bind exact repository, base commit, ordered PR and head identities, merge strategy and tool version, conflict policy, contract manifest, required profiles, policy revision, and idempotency
qualify and retain the exact synthesized tree plus gate and artifact identities
record one durable external-effect intent before provider dispatch
record per-PR merged, failed, and unknown outcomes without assuming rollback
reconcile timeout, cancellation, transport failure, crash, and ambiguous provider results against authoritative provider state
bound retries and prohibit retry of an unknown attempt until reconciliation
serialize conflicting release operations and make concurrent workers converge
accept a story only after author approval and authoritative verification that all required PRs are merged and the provider tree equals the qualified tree

findings.finding: Contract 0.4.0 defines no release-plan aggregate kind and no release command or event types.

The story-acceptance payload cannot identify a release plan, plan revision, finalization event, repository, exact base and ordered heads, required PRs, provider observations, per-PR outcomes, or reconciliation state.

INV-013 states exact merge-tree qualification but its only named fixture is the generic idempotency scenario; the released corpus contains no release-plan transition, partial-outcome, ambiguity, reconciliation, concurrent-worker, changed-head/base, or non-code-story model.

Using evidence IDs or qualified_tree_digest alone as an implicit release record would move required release semantics outside the normative replayable contract and would permit acceptance without proving the accepted deterministic release conditions.

minimumSuccessorEncoding.storyAcceptanceRevision: Require release_plan_id, release_plan_revision, release_finalized_event_id, and qualified_tree_digest for code stories; retain an explicit finalized NO_RELEASE_REQUIRED path for non-code stories.
requiredModels: canonical frozen release plan and semantic plan key
durable execution intent and per-PR attempt identity
MERGED, ALREADY_MERGED, FAILED, and UNKNOWN provider outcomes
authoritative reconciliation that supersedes UNKNOWN without rewriting history
partial multi-PR join and terminal release outcome
story acceptance gated by exact finalized release state

conclusion: Do not implement deterministic release or organizational acceptance against contract 0.4.0. Create and separately qualify immutable successor contract 0.5.0 before implementation.
authorityRequired: Explicit principal approval is required before creating or releasing contract 0.5.0.
